description: Na₂NbAlSi₂SO₁₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.94 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.81 Å. Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.09 Å. Al is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted AlO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Al-O bond distances ranging from 1.79-2.29 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NbO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent AlO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 20-37°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.67 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NbO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent AlO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 17-33°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.69 Å. S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NbO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent AlO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 27-36°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.45-1.53 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Al and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Al and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Nb, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Nb and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Nb, and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal pyramidal geometry to two Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Al, and one S atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Nb, and one S atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Nb, and one Si atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Nb, and one Si atom.
